text:
QUOTE: "Callbacks run on the engine thread via `process_events()`, not on the monitor thread." and "health events are queued and delivered on the engine thread, so consumer code never runs on the monitor thread."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the health monitor queues events (guarded by `event_mutex_`) and delivers callbacks on the engine thread via `process_events()`, not the monitor thread.
